newsitem.title: USA: GM February Catera sales rise over January.
newsitem.headline: GM February Catera sales rise over January.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Monday February sales of its Cadillac Catera were 2,232, a 33 percent gain over 1,673 sold in January.

Year-ago figures are not available because the entry level luxury car was introduced in October. Monthly Catera sales were released before those of GM, which is scheduled to report total sales later Monday.
Preliminary consumer research shows 41 percent of Catera buyers are under the age of 50, and half are women.

"This sales acceleration is right on target with our launch plans," David Nottoli, Catera brand manager, said in a statement. "We are confident that we will continue to see sales growth as we move into the spring selling season."
Including February sales, 1997 model year Catera sales since October are 5,581.
